views.name: business_funnel_metrics
views.definition:
SELECT ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM reportable_ai_call_records) AS total_calls,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM reportable_ai_call_records
          WHERE (reportable_ai_call_records.disposition <> ALL (ARRAY['no_answer'::text, 'voicemail'::text, 'unknown'::text, 'wrong_number'::text]))) AS conversations,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM reportable_ai_call_records
          WHERE (reportable_ai_call_records.disposition = ANY (ARRAY['warm'::text, 'hot'::text, 'appointment_set'::text, 'callback'::text]))) AS interested,
    ( SELECT count(DISTINCT reportable_ai_call_records.lead_id) AS count
           FROM reportable_ai_call_records
          WHERE (reportable_ai_call_records.disposition = ANY (ARRAY['warm'::text, 'hot'::text, 'appointment_set'::text]))) AS hot_leads,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM reportable_appointments
          WHERE (reportable_appointments.status = ANY (ARRAY['scheduled'::text, 'confirmed'::text, 'completed'::text]))) AS appointments,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM reportable_appointments
          WHERE (reportable_appointments.status = 'completed'::text)) AS appointments_completed,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM reportable_deals
          WHERE ((reportable_deals.stage = 'closed'::text) AND (reportable_deals.actual_close_date IS NOT NULL))) AS contracts_closed,
    ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(reportable_deals.assignment_fee), (0)::numeric) AS "coalesce"
           FROM reportable_deals
          WHERE ((reportable_deals.stage = 'closed'::text) AND (reportable_deals.actual_close_date IS NOT NULL))) AS closed_fees;

    b.total_purchases_12mo,
    b.properties_owned,

    b.last_purchase_date,

    b.deals_closed,
    b.pof_verified,
    b.pof_amount,
    b.target_zips,
    b.min_price,
    b.max_price,
    b.tier AS crm_tier,
    b.active,
    b.sms_opt_in,
    b.email_opt_in,
    b.outreach_ignore_count,
    b.last_scored_at,
    b.created_at,
    (count(DISTINCT bt.id))::integer AS transaction_count,
    max(bt.purchase_date) AS most_recent_purchase
   FROM (buyers b
     LEFT JOIN buyer_transactions bt ON ((bt.buyer_id = b.id)))
  WHERE (b.active = true)
  GROUP BY b.id
  ORDER BY b.ibie_score DESC NULLS LAST;

views.name: funnel_metrics
views.definition:
SELECT count(*) AS total_leads,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (priority_tier = 'A'::text)) AS tier_a,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (priority_tier = 'B'::text)) AS tier_b,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (priority_tier = 'C'::text)) AS tier_c,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (priority_tier = 'D'::text)) AS tier_d,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (seller_score >= 70)) AS calling_eligible,
    ( SELECT business_funnel_metrics.total_calls
           FROM business_funnel_metrics) AS total_calls,
    ( SELECT business_funnel_metrics.conversations
           FROM business_funnel_metrics) AS conversations,
    ( SELECT business_funnel_metrics.interested
           FROM business_funnel_metrics) AS interested,
    ( SELECT count(DISTINCT reportable_qualification_results.lead_id) AS count
           FROM reportable_qualification_results
          WHERE (reportable_qualification_results.classification = 'WARM'::text)) AS warm_leads,
    ( SELECT count(DISTINCT reportable_ai_call_records.lead_id) AS count
           FROM reportable_ai_call_records
          WHERE (reportable_ai_call_records.disposition = 'hot'::text)) AS hot_leads,
    ( SELECT business_funnel_metrics.appointments
           FROM business_funnel_metrics) AS appointments,
    ( SELECT business_funnel_metrics.contracts_closed
           FROM business_funnel_metrics) AS contracts_closed
   FROM reportable_leads;

views.name: stack_analytics
views.definition:
WITH lead_groups AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(l.stack_name, 'No Stack'::text) AS stack_name,
            count(*) AS total_leads,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE (l.precision_tier = 1)) AS tier_1_leads,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE (l.status = ANY (ARRAY['hot'::text, 'appointment_set'::text, 'contract'::text]))) AS converted_leads,
            round((((count(*) FILTER (WHERE (l.status = ANY (ARRAY['hot'::text, 'appointment_set'::text, 'contract'::text]))))::numeric / (NULLIF(count(*), 0))::numeric) * (100)::numeric), 2) AS conversion_pct,
            round(avg(l.seller_score), 1) AS avg_seller_score
           FROM reportable_leads l
          GROUP BY COALESCE(l.stack_name, 'No Stack'::text)
        ), closed_fees AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(l.stack_name, 'No Stack'::text) AS stack_name,
            round(avg(d.assignment_fee), '-3'::integer) AS avg_assignment_fee
           FROM (reportable_deals d
             JOIN reportable_leads l ON ((l.id = d.lead_id)))
          WHERE ((d.stage = 'closed'::text) AND (d.actual_close_date IS NOT NULL))
          GROUP BY COALESCE(l.stack_name, 'No Stack'::text)
        )
 SELECT g.stack_name,
    g.total_leads,
    g.tier_1_leads,
    g.converted_leads,
    g.conversion_pct,
    f.avg_assignment_fee,
    g.avg_seller_score
   FROM (lead_groups g
     LEFT JOIN closed_fees f USING (stack_name))
  ORDER BY g.tier_1_leads DESC, g.total_leads DESC;
